breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a more detailed 'Strang splitting' scheme. The ground truth resolves this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent correctly identified the more specific 'Strang splitting' method as the intended one and did not include any mention of 'Explicit forward Euler' in its generated specification, thus resolving the conflict.
